**Note:** PiGallery2 is a hobby project with a single maintainer and only a few new features a year.
To keep the app simple, new features should be done with a setting, a theme or an [extension](https://bpatrik.github.io/pigallery2/development/extensions) when possible.
Feature requests that the maintainer does not need have a low chance of being implemented. For ideas and questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/bpatrik/pigallery2/discussions) is a better place.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Can it be done without changing the app?**
- Is there a [setting](https://bpatrik.github.io/pigallery2/user-guide/configuration) for it? (The admin page shows all settings in "Under the hood" mode.)
- Can a theme (custom CSS, `Gallery.Themes` setting) do it?
- Can an [extension](https://bpatrik.github.io/pigallery2/development/extensions) do it? If not, what is missing from the extension API?

**Describe alternatives you've considered** (optional)
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
